exec $MCPDIFF -calls a.mcp ids.mcp
! stdout .
exec $MCPDIFF -calls -json a.mcp ids.mcp
stdout '^\[\]'
! exec $MCPDIFF -calls a.mcp changed.mcp
stdout 'response result or error changed'
stderr '^$'
! exec $MCPDIFF -calls a.mcp incomplete.mcp
stderr 'no response observed'
! exec $MCPDIFF -calls -timing a.mcp ids.mcp
stderr 'duration unavailable'

-- a.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
mcp-recv {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"n":9007199254740993}}
-- ids.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"different","method":"ping"}
mcp-recv {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"different","result":{"n":9007199254740993}}
-- changed.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
mcp-recv {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"error":{"code":-1,"message":"failed"}}
-- incomplete.mcp --
mcp-send {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
